description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldText class for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, extending the SugarWidgetFieldVarchar class. It provides methods for filtering text fields in database queries and rendering list displays, specifically handling text data types within the CRM's widget framework.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldText
classes.description: A widget class for handling text fields in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework, extending the varchar field widget to implement text-specific filtering and display functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the widget with the layout manager by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: queryFilterEquals
methods.description: Generates SQL for filtering records where the text field equals a given input.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Equals_Str
methods.description: Generates SQL for filtering records where the text field does not equal a given input, considering NULLs.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Empty
methods.description: Generates SQL for filtering records where the text field is not empty.

methods.name: queryFilterEmpty
methods.description: Generates SQL for filtering records where the text field is empty.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Returns the display string for the list view, converting newlines to HTML line breaks.
